title: Jill's Dairy — Mbira Folk (Zimbabwe)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm alto female vocal 82bpm analog tape warm dawn storytelling Shona heritage
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Before the rooster, Jill was already there
The dairy cool and dark, the cows beyond the gate
She knew them all by sound before she knew by sight
The rhythm of the milking was the rhythm of first light

[Verse 2]
The milk that left the farm before the town was up
Fed the workers, fed the neighbours, filled the morning cup
Jill didn't run the dairy — the dairy ran through her
Every calf she'd named, every season she'd endure

[Chorus]
Jill's dairy in the four AM
Mbira in the morning, hosho and the stem
Forty cows and Jill knows every one
This is the work that's done before the sun

[Bridge]
When Kerri left for Australia she took this with her
The four AM knowing, the quiet before the stir
Joel found it in her stillness, that particular calm
That comes from a woman raised on a Zimbabwe farm

[Verse 3]
The farm was sold but Jill's rhythm stayed
In the way her daughter moves, the way her daughter prayed
Not to any altar — to the morning and the land
And to the way a dairy teaches you to use your hands

[Outro]
Jill's dairy
Jill's dairy
Four in the morning
Jill's dairy lives on
